message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Though it premiered in 2019, its impact carried over into 2020, earning it the Academy Award for Best Picture and topping many year‑end “best of” lists. Its blend of sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho made it a cultural touchstone that resonated worldwide. If you’re looking for a film that defined the year, “Parasite” is the one to watch.
